stage.name: Gone the Ages Past
stage.description:
Condition: 

<Sui-Xiang> [Omnidirectional Breath] damage increased

<'Free'> [Break the Chains] barrier damage absorption increased, [Weft and Warp] damage greatly increased.

<Ya> Summoned Paradise has increased HP., and 'Winter's Void' summons <Shanhaizhong Phalanx> instead.

All Elites and Bosses have increased HP, and all enemies have increased ATK and max HP.

wisp.name: Wisp
wisp.flavourText: An everlasting will-o'-the-wisp shed from Sui-Xiang's body.
abilities: Cannot be blocked.
Must be damaged 10 times to defeat
After coming into contact with <Sui-Xiang's> <Dantian>, grants it increased Starting HP
After entering Sui-Xiang's Third Form, grants SP to its [Omnidirectional Breath]

anxious_angry.name: Anxious 'Angry'
anxious_angry.flavourText: A beastly Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. It has an even worse temper and doesn't want to eat apricots anymore. It follows its master's wishes and frolics about in the painting scroll, occasionally taking a bite out of it.

raging_di_beast.name: Raging Di Beast
raging_di_beast.flavourText: One of Ya's off-handed creations, its bloodlust honed by the golden sands. It is extremely keen of hearing and stalks the streets like a shadow, both fighting and collecting and relaying information.

shanhaizhong_phalanx.name: Shanhaizhong Phalanx
shanhaizhong_phalanx.flavourText: A Shanhaizhong member tasked with defense. The Shanhaizhong have recruited many desperadoes, many of them were the disasters of their places. With their burly physiques and special heavy shields, they are a threatening line of defense.

shanhaizhong_harbinger.name: Shanhaizhong Harbinger
shanhaizhong_harbinger.flavourText: A Shanhaizhong member responsible for analyzing intel and relaying tactical orders. With their use of ciphers, they're more like trained professionals than a disorganized band of rogues.
abilities: Deploys a Shanhaizhong Cipher Machine on the first deployable Yumen Catastrophe Defenses

flanking_stabby.name: Flanking 'Stabby'
flanking_stabby.flavourText: A crafty Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. Very proud of itself and its tricks. Instinctively suppresses its enemies by attacking their weak spots for damage. It will prioritize attacking opposite attribute enemies.
abilities: Prioritize attacking opposite attribute enemies

shanhaizhong_vigilante.name: Shanhaizhong Vigilante
shanhaizhong_vigilante.flavourText: An ordinary Shanhaizhong member with a complex past. Their ridiculous slogan of 'the mounts, seas, and all in between shall be our master's' has spurred a large group of bandits to make trouble all over Yan, and many of them are involved in lawsuits.
abilities: Can appear in the battlefield
Gains increased Attack Range when on Yumen Catastrophe Defenses

grindstone.name: Grindstone
grindstone.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. All blades must be sharpened to not lose their edge. A Waregeist of this type tends to be timid and will dash out of harm's way at the first sign of danger.
abilities: Spawns 2 <Wooden Seals> when defeated

vernacularism.name: Vernacularism
vernacularism.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. The world is a strange place, but there is joy to be had. A Waregeist of this type is unusually energetic and likes to hang out with other Waregeists.
abilities: Spawns 3 <Novel Scrolls> when defeated

shanhaizhong_secret_keeper.name: Shanhaizhong Secret-Keeper
shanhaizhong_secret_keeper.flavourText: A Shanhaizhong leader with a mysterious mission. Elusive, merciless, and unconcerned with their men's sacrifices. What are they really planning behind that fog of faith?
abilities: Invisible
The next attack made after breaking Invisibility will deal increased damage

complicated_envy.name: Complicated 'Envy'
complicated_envy.flavourText: A fearsome Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. Frightening in appearance and feared by all. Very territorial and doesn't get along with most other Ink Spirits. Its emotions and behavioral patterns are particularly complex, perhaps even more so than mere man. Arts can shift Hui and Ming.
abilities: Can charge its attacks. If not interrupted, causes Arts damage and shifts target's Ming and Hui attribute.

unbridled_fury.name: Unbridled 'Fury'
unbridled_fury.flavourText: A strong Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. Its great power and might is how it frees itself from the worries of having to think, allowing it to destroy all in its wake with its flaming inferno. Other than its buddy Bitey, that is. Gains attack power against opposite attribute enemies.
abilities: Greatly increases ATK when attacking opposite attribute targets

unmoving_lazy.name: Unmoving 'Lazy'
unmoving_lazy.flavourText: A majestic Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. Looks weird, just like it's carrying a mountain on its back. As still as a mountain when not moving, but bears down on its enemies like boulders tumbling down a mountain when in a team. Can draw enemies to attack it, unfathomably tough.
abilities: More likely to be targeted by attacks.

free.name: 'Free'
free.flavourText: A monster drawn by Dusk. It has a commanding presence and chilling arrogance, as though taking a page out of its master's book. 'The virid beasts. Like range on range. Eleven told. In moon, smoke-flow.'
abilities: First Form
[Weft and Warp] Deals Arts damage to targets in the surrounding cross area, changing Hui-Ming attributes within its range
[Break the Chains] Deals massive damage in a large radius if the Barrier is not destroyed before it expires.
The first time HP drops to 0, enters Second Form
Second Form
Changes own Hui-Ming Attribute
Gains increased ATK and normal attacks hit twice
Additionally unleashes [Weft and Warp] on farthest target

ya.name: 'Ya'
ya.flavourText: The executor of the Feranmut, 'Ya.' According to the Sui Regulators' ancient scrolls, one of the Feranmuts hunted by the Yan a thousand years ago, with the mystical ability to 'cut away the seasons and hold them at Its bosom.' Its wounds still refuse to close, and It laps at them in fury and bewilderment... It returns once more to familiar Yan soil.
abilities: Applies 'Winter's Void' on tiles It travels over, which continuously summons enemies
First Form
[Spring's Birth] When blocked, summons a Mirage that applies 'Winter's Void' to tiles it travels over. If not defeated after some time, 'Ya' teleports to its location
Second Form
Gains increased Attack Range, attacks become ranged
Gains Low-Altitude Hovering

[Autumn's Bounty] Summons a Delusion that has similar abilities to 'Ya' and also applies 'Winter's Void' to tiles it travels over. When 'Ya' is defeated, the Delusion also dies; if the Delusion dies, 'Ya' loses a percentage of Its max HP
[Slice the Seasons] 'Ya' and Delusion deal AoE damage, then switch places and routes
[Worldly Self] 'Ya' and Delusion deal AoE damage to surrounding units
